blocks.text: VALENCIA CITY, Bukidnon — Police are probing two separate shooting incidents that rocked this city on Sunday evening, leaving one dead and another wounded. The first victim was a 56-year-old businessman, a resident of Purok 3, Kurbada, Barangay Tongantongan, Valencia City, who was found dead in a pool of blood inside his room by responding officers. The second victim was a 45-year-old hospital employee and resident of Midsayap, North Cotabato, who was ambushed in Barangay Sinayawan. Both cases involve armed attacks resulting in severe gunshot wounds, with investigators recovering cal. .45, 9mm, and .38 revolver slugs at the first crime scene. […]...
